confirmed_defects.title: Tautological ZIP determinism assertion in build tests
confirmed_defects.evidence: `ok($ha eq $ha, 'zip writer is deterministic for identical input')` compared a value to itself, so the test could never fail; the same suite runs in CI-less pipeline currently
confirmed_defects.impact: a non-deterministic ZIP writer would pass the suite silently
confirmed_defects.fix: writes the same entry list twice and asserts identical output; asserts reverse-order input differs

confirmed_defects.title: Stale component manifest after dylib pin refresh
confirmed_defects.evidence: manifest recorded sha256 512b729db93e8ac3287735c75700975128fb6a5efc5659a72b52949e7f7bb587 / size 1747536 for dylibs/spotifyglass.dylib; HEAD blob (after commit db3ccd6 'refresh the pinned spotifyglass component to the rebrand CI build') is e633f9244c239f40598d0ae4bb4c35cab86fed40d77fa2168f7c489947759046 / 1816144
confirmed_defects.impact: pin-and-verify pipeline had no truthful record; drift undetectable by any existing test
confirmed_defects.fix: manifest updated to blob values; provenance note 'spotifyglass_refresh' added

confirmed_defects.title: Shipped CydiaSubstrate in released IPA differs from repo pin; manifest recorded no hash
confirmed_defects.evidence: shipped PwEevee-0.22.0-alpha.2-unified IPA contains Frameworks/CydiaSubstrate.framework/CydiaSubstrate with sha256 748d129f68a3a262e8908d5748d185dec301c737acb496db36ab9497ce3c794d size 377952, byte-identical to Taurus-0.60.4's; repo HEAD blob is 3c691ec7339a760d12080974c13ad45db6a3e25df42f7689b760ff76a211ea8a size 403200; manifest.json contained no binary hash
confirmed_defects.impact: released artifact is not reproducible from the repo; substrate origin (Taurus stack) undocumented
confirmed_defects.status: PARTIALLY FIXED (pin recorded + enforced by test; artifact reconciliation is a release-engineering decision)

confirmed_defects.title: dependencies.json $comment sizeofcmds drift
confirmed_defects.evidence: comment states audited ncmds 153 / sizeofcmds 16680; shipped unified main binary has ncmds 153 / sizeofcmds 16824
confirmed_defects.confidence: high (comment drift certain; which artifact the comment describes is unverified)
confirmed_defects.status: OPEN (needs the proven com.spotipw_0.22.0.ipa, not present in working tree)

confirmed_defects.title: Weak @rpath load-command injections are undeclared and unvalidated
confirmed_defects.evidence: shipped main binary carries weak loads @rpath/SpotifyGlassAppGroups.dylib and @rpath/spotifyglass.dylib (cmd 145/146) not present in expected_load_commands and not checked by validate-macho.pl; Taurus shows the same pattern plus SpotifyAudioProbe, chroma the same two
confirmed_defects.impact: injector leftovers invisible to the validator; weak/strong duplicate dylib loads unresolved by policy
confirmed_defects.fix: declare the weak set in dependencies.json and validate both strong + weak sets, or document as upstream-injector constraint

confirmed_defects.title: No CI workflow runs any build-system test suite
confirmed_defects.evidence: grep for perl invocation of tests/ in workflows matches nothing
confirmed_defects.impact: defects like D-1/D-2 ship without any gate
confirmed_defects.fix: add a CI job running all test suites with fail-fast

package_findings.title: Main-app code signature cleared but not rebuilt in all four IPAs
package_findings.evidence: LC_CODE_SIGNATURE with implausible off=3240283899 size=222174078 in all four main binaries
package_findings.impact: install routes must re-sign (expected for decrypted redistributions)

package_findings.title: Watch app absent from all three forks
package_findings.evidence: stock has Watch/WatchApp.app tree; PwEevee/Taurus/chroma do not
package_findings.impact: watch features unavailable (expected; unchanged from pin evidence in dependencies.json comment)

package_findings.title: chroma keeps stock Spotify build metadata and sets CFBundleIconName=SGPrimaryIcon
package_findings.evidence: info.flat.txt values (SpotifyBuildTimestamp 1791216420, CFBundleIconName SGPrimaryIcon only in chroma)
package_findings.impact: interpretation: chroma likely uses the alternate-icon API rather than asset replacement
package_findings.confidence: high for the plist values; the interpretation is inferred

package_findings.title: PwEevee α.2 ships two 'extra' weak injections vs Taurus (SpotifyGlassLiveActivity.appex aligns)

issues_investigated.title: Crash When Changing the App Icon in LiveContainer
issues_investigated.code_trace: Spotipw/tweak/Sources/App/Eevee/SGEevee.x — loadIcons/choose use filename-stem keys for sideload safety; setAlternateIconName with rollback on completion-error
issues_investigated.verdict: upstream environment limitation (LiveContainer host): the icon-change API needs a real imageRef inside the app bundle; the crash happens before PwEevee's completion handler runs. Not a PwEevee regression.
issues_investigated.mitigation_recommendation: detect LiveContainer-style host and show an explicit unsupported notice instead of attempting the icon change

issues_investigated.title: Cant download songs
issues_investigated.code_trace: spotipw/EeveeSpotify stack provides UI/audio-path tweaks; no code path in Spotipw/ claims to enable offline downloads on stock iOS 18
issues_investigated.verdict: platform limitation: Spotify offline downloads are server-enforced; non-jailbroken sideload cannot fabricate attestation. Not owned by PwEevee.
issues_investigated.mitigation_recommendation: document prominently in README/website as an expected limitation
